task.description: Validate REQ-006: testability of every criterion (the check is runnable as written), fidelity to the owner's decision «Делай» on ORCH's plan (reviews file section 4) and the reviewer condition (section 3), consistency with REQ-005, WF-07, the role mandates and tools/ commands, no bar lowering. Rule on each of the analyst's open questions.
acceptance_criteria: each finding is located (criterion number or file:line) with severity and a concrete fix

each analyst open question gets a ruling

result.summary:
REQ-VALIDATOR verdict: FAIL. REQ-006 goes back to REQ-ANALYST. 5 blocking findings, 7 minor. Research (step 1) must not start.

BLOCKING
B1 [fidelity/testability] AC4 and AC5 (docs/requirements.yaml:258-259). The reviewer's condition (reviews file:68) asks for ONE sentence that says both what the $10 buys and «почему это нельзя получить тем же способом в Claude/Copilot/Pretty Prompt». AC4 requires the sentence to name only who pays, «$10 в месяц», the result and the elements. The «why not elsewhere» part is delegated to the table, so a sentence without it passes AC4 and AC5. The requirement's own description (lines 192-197) does require it, so the criteria are weaker than the description. Fix: AC4 — the value line names Claude, Copilot and Pretty Prompt (grep -F for each on the extracted line) and says why the result cannot be had the same way there. AC5 — add a «по существу» FAIL: «фраза не говорит, почему результат нельзя получить тем же способом в Claude/Copilot/Pretty Prompt».
B2 [fidelity] Rework at the value gate (description lines 200-202; AC5 line 259 «FAIL «оформление»»; AC6 line 260 «третий по счёту 2b», «доработка 2a ... не больше двух»). Item 3 of the plan the owner approved (reviews file:77) says «Автор пишет фразу, проверяющий принимает или отклоняет. Отклонил — стоп, итог «рано»». REQ-006 lets the author rework after a formatting FAIL, and the description cites «(план, п. 3)» for a substance/formatting split the plan does not make. That attributes to the owner-approved plan something it does not say. Fix, one of two: (a) any 2b FAIL gives «рано»; remove the 2a/2b -rN path and «третий по счёту 2b»; «вид» in result.reasons may stay for the «рано» document. (b) Keep the formatting path only with the owner's written confirmation in decisions/NNNN-*.md (Q12), recorded before the «до» snapshot and cited in REQ-006. In both cases remove «(план, п. 3)» from the split.
B3 [testability] AC14 (line 268): «в снимке нет строк с session-review- и step-01-». I ran `npm run snapshot` into my scratchpad: grep -c 'step-01-' is already 9, from handoffs/BP-20260929-01/step-01-* and step-01b-*. A correct run fails this check. Fix: grep -cE 'handoffs/<BP-ID>/step-01|session-review-' must be 0. I ran this on today's snapshot: 0.
B4 [consistency, Q14] AC14's snapshot-diff allowlist excludes STATE.md and docs/requirements.yaml. STATE.md:3 says «Обновляется в конце каждой рабочей сессии», and [образец] WF-02 (lines 17 and 105), which orchestrator.md:6-8 adopts, has ORCH flip pending -> in_progress after the gate. A run that crosses a session boundary, or a status flip after the snapshot, makes snapshot-diff exit 1, and AP-007 then forces a rerun with a new BP-ID. Fix: add `--allow STATE.md` (its content is checked at step 5). State explicitly that ORCH sets REQ-006 in_progress, if at all, before the «до» snapshot, and that docs/requirements.yaml is otherwise not touched until step 5 (done or blocked).
B5 [consistency] The mandates are frozen for the run (description lines 231-232, AC14), but they are specific to REQ-005:
- plan-validator.md:20 says «REQ-005 acceptance criteria govern» (step 1b).
- plan-validator.md:35-36 FAILs a plan if «a required section of REQ-005 is missing, or the 30-day plan lacks checkable results or numeric kill criteria». A step-3 validator that follows its mandate must therefore FAIL a correct «рано» document, which ends in blocked. The «законное завершение» the requirement declares cannot be reached.
- plan-validator.md has no step 2b.
- plan-writer.md:21-25 lists sources that exclude handoffs, but AC8 (line 262) requires the «рано» document to quote the 2a/2b handoffs.
- WF-07 lines 6, 20, 37, 44 and 46 name REQ-005.
The analyst's open question 4 covers only 1b, and not in any criterion. Fix, one of two: (a) before the «до» snapshot, ORCH generalizes these lines to «требование прогона» with a decisions/ record (AP-011 note); or (b) add a criterion: the task.description of every 1b, 2a, 2b, 2c and 3 handoff says that REQ-006 criteria govern wherever the mandate names REQ-005 and that the 30-day-plan/kill-criteria check does not apply to the «рано» document, and 2c lists the 2a/2b handoffs as inputs. Check: jq -r .task.description | grep -F REQ-006.

MINOR (fix in the same rework)
M1 AC12 (line 266): grep -cE 'Д7|активных пользовател' is case-sensitive and narrow. On the test text «Активных пользователей мало. / Активные пользователи. / Д7» it matched only Д7. Fix: grep -ciE 'Д7|активн[[:alpha:]]* пользовател', which matched 3 of 3.
M2 AC1 (line 255): «каждый исследователь пишет только свой файл (AP-008)» has no check. Fix: jq that each step-01 handoff's result.artifacts_out is exactly its own file; or drop the clause, since it is already a mandate rule.
M3 AC10 (line 264): «сам открывает не меньше 5 первоисточников» can be impossible for a «рано» document with fewer citations. Fix: «не меньше 5, а если их в документе меньше — все».
M4 AC17 (line 271) has no failure path. If ORCH's check fails, the status is already done. Fix: on FAIL, DOC-UPDATER reworks in step-05-doc-updater-rN.json with result.changes and ORCH re-checks; at most two reworks, then blocked; done stands only after ORCH's check passes.
M5 AC15 (line 269): «по всем критериям этого требования о документе» should list the criterion numbers (4, 7-13). AC3 (line 257): change «после второй FAIL» to «FAIL после второй доработки» to match AC15.
M6 [fidelity, provenance] These items are not in the §4 list the owner approved; they come from ORCH's step-00a task, reviewer §1 and ORCH §2: «## Цифры в сценариях» (AC11), «### Промежуточные сигналы» (AC12), «## Что нужно узнать сначала» (AC8) and the WF-07 variant section (AC17 г). They do not lower the bar and are not attributed to the owner, so they may stay. Fix: the description names their origin, so the owner can strike them.
M7 [AP-012] The description (lines 195-196) states a competitor fact: «входит в подписку Microsoft Copilot». pixel-office.md:169 adds a community report that it is also in free Copilot Chat, and ORCH §2 says «бесплатный». REQ-006 does not need this fact. Fix: keep only the pointer «research/pixel-office.md, строки 167-169». Separately, AC2 attributes the «Claude (приложения и claude.ai)» row to «research/pixel-office.md, разделы 2 и 7», but those sections do not mention claude.ai (grep: 0). Attribute that row to the reviewer's «Claude» (§3). Nothing else presupposes market facts: whole-session review in Claude Code is posed as a question (description 210-213; AC2 heading «### 1. Есть ли ...?»; AC3).

CHECKS I RAN
- YAML parses with ruby Psych (REQ-001..006). REQ-006 has the same 8 keys as the others, status pending, 17 criteria, and each has «Проверка». depends_on [REQ-005] is correct: README, research/pixel-office.md, WF-07 and the WF-07 mandates are REQ-005 outputs, and REQ-005 is done.
- Verbatim script (scratchpad/verbatim.rb): the plan quote equals reviews §4 after whitespace normalization (true); the reviewer quote is present in §3 with ** removed (true); «> Делай» is in §5 (true). Nothing beyond «Делай» and forwarding the reviews (reviews:3) is attributed to the owner, except B2's «(план, п. 3)».
- Each cited README.md line printed with sed -n:
  - 420-421: payments from abroad not checked
  - 503: Д6 $10
  - 504: Д7 2%
  - 570: «Выяснить до страницы с предоплатой»
  - 571: R2 demo
  - 578-580: only money received counts
  - 586: step 2 page, with «продукта ещё нет» and refund
  - 593-595: stop criterion (594 «3 из 300», 595 «1% ... Д7»)
  All match. pixel-office.md:167 is Pretty Prompt and :168 is Microsoft Prompt Coach — both match.
- tools: node v22.21.1. `npm run snapshot -- <scratchpad>/before.txt` exited 0 (204 files). `npm run snapshot-diff` with AC14's exact --allow list exited 0. sha256sum and jq are present.
- Synthetic brief in the scratchpad: these AC4/AC7/AC9 checks all run and decide correctly — awk value-line extraction (1 line), wc -w, the [.!?] count, grep '^## ', grep -Fx on the table header, grep -x «Итог: ...», and awk section removal + grep -ciE 'кпп|конвейер|квиз'. Cyrillic -i works in BSD grep under C.UTF-8.
- jq on step-00a/00b: the agent_run_ids differ (a4782636cdabc16f1 / a2b608647992e7635); created_at == started_at is true for both.
- Q/R sweep: the work is documents only. Q8, R3 and Q10 are not applicable, and the requirement says why (description 250-253). Q4, Q5, Q7, Q9 and Q11 are not applicable (no code). Q2 producer/checker pairs: 00a/00b, 1/1b, 2a/2b, 2c/3, all/4, 5/ORCH. R2 is covered by AC12's demo rule; Q13 and Q14 by step 5. No wording lowers the bar; the only Q14 conflict is B4.

RULINGS ON THE ANALYST'S OPEN QUESTIONS
(1) Substance vs formatting rework: not accepted as written, see B2. The owner's words are the default: any FAIL gives «рано». The variant needs his written decision. An optional mitigation that is not a rework: in the 2a handoff the author attaches his own output of the mechanical checks (awk/wc/grep).
(2) Prompt Coach as a separate row from GitHub Copilot: accepted. «Copilot» in the reviewer's text is ambiguous, and ORCH §2 ties Prompt Coach to Copilot, so covering both is faithful. Apply M7.
(3) 1500 and 60 words: accepted as the analyst's conversions, which Q1 needs. There is correctly no lower bound, because of «рано». The description must mark them as the analyst's numbers, not the owner's. wc -w also counts table «|» tokens; that is deterministic and acceptable. Under ruling (1) the 60-word limit decides the outcome, and the owner may widen it.
(4) README facts carried as line numbers, no mandate change: the lines are verified, and requirements.yaml is in the plan-writer's sources, so this works for facts. «No mandate change» is not enough, see B5.
(5) Step 5 checked by ORCH: accepted. It matches Q14 («ORCH сверяет конкретные поля до записи DONE») and doc-updater.md:25, and Q2 holds (DOC-UPDATER is not ORCH). Add the failure path (M4).
(6) File names and snapshot location: accepted. They are consistent with the BP-20260929-01 naming (step-01-...-<line>, -rN), snapshot-before.txt sits under the allowed prefix, and its sha256 is pinned in the step-1 handoffs. Fix the grep (B3).
(7) 17 criteria, split or not: no split. The deliverables are one five-item chain the owner approved, not unrelated work. A research-only or bookkeeping-only requirement would have no value of its own, and REQ-005 is the precedent. Shorten the wording where possible.

Re-validation after the rework: a new 00b round (step-00b-req-validator-r2.json), not an edit of this file.
